topIssues.title: op-proposer: sepolia devnet has timestamp as rootBlockNumber
topIssues.author: stevennevins
topIssues.body:
**Bug Description**

The anchorStateRegistry has a timestamp-like value for the current anchorState and not a block number. Causing the check for UnexpectedRoot claim to fire

**Steps to Reproduce**

Grabbed the DisputeGameFactory from: 
k8s/opc/oplabs-dev-client/sepolia-devnet-0-proposer/values.yaml

Grabbed a the most recently created game at the time
DGF: 0x2419423C72998eb1c6c15A235de2f112f8E38efF (version = 1.0.0)
- gameType = 0
- game = 0xd39c84C753cEfe26bE03f75E1C6dbae3ec7966c7
- createdAt = 1771934412 (2026-02-24 12:00:12 UTC)

Grab the ASR from the Game
- anchorStateRegistry = 0x03b82ae60989863bceb0bbd442a70568e5aefb85 (version = 0.1.0)


l2BlockNumber() = 1771934409 (2026-02-24 12:00:09 UTC)
rootClaim() = 0xdeadbeef...deadbeef

The new game attempted to be created has a block number, 32562796

This results in a failure for the check:
if (l2BlockNumber() <= rootBlockNumber) revert UnexpectedRootClaim(rootClaim());

Becaues the rootBlockNumber on the ASR is > the l2BlockNumber of the new game

**Expected behavior**

Creating a game successfully and it's l2BlockNumber should be greater than the on stored on the ASR

**Environment Information:**
N/A

**Configurations:**
N/A

The initial error logs:

topIssues.title: op-reth: re-enable p2p::can_sync test after upstream reth fix
topIssues.author: theochap
topIssues.body:
## Summary

The `p2p::can_sync` e2e test in `reth-optimism-node` is currently ignored because it crashes with SIGABRT due to an incorrect `debug_assert!` in upstream reth v1.11.1.

## Root Cause

`DeferredTrie::wait_cloned` in `reth-chain-state` has a `debug_assert!` that panics when called from a rayon worker thread. Proof workers legitimately run on rayon, so this assertion is incorrect.

## Upstream Fix

The assertion was removed in https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/22505. This fix is not yet included in any reth release tag (latest is v1.11.1).

## Action

Once a new reth release includes the fix, bump the reth dependency and remove the `#[ignore]` from the test in `rust/op-reth/crates/node/tests/e2e-testsuite/p2p.rs`.

topPRs.title: sc-feat: policy engine staking ordering
topPRs.author: ashitakah
topPRs.body:
**PolicyEngineStaking** is a periphery contract that enables stake-aware transaction ordering in op-rbuilder.

Users deposit OP tokens and optionally link their stake to a beneficiary that receives ordering power. The contract maintains an aggregated, PE-optimized view of effective stake and last update timestamp per address in a single packed storage slot, allowing the Policy Engine to read stake data directly via state_by_block_hash() with O(1) lookups and no RPC calls.

topPRs.title: op-devstack: add capability interfaces for polymorphic lookups (Phase 3)
topPRs.author: teddyknox
topPRs.body:
This PR introduces capability interfaces for op-devstack that enable polymorphic lookups across component types with different ID signatures. This is Phase 3 of the ID type system refactor.

### Problem

Components like `RollupBoostNode` and `OPRBuilderNode` provide L2 EL functionality but can't implement `L2ELNode` because their `ID()` methods return different types:

```go
// L2ELNode has: ID() L2ELNodeID
// RollupBoostNode has: ID() RollupBoostNodeID
// OPRBuilderNode has: ID() OPRBuilderNodeID
```

This forced manual multi-registry lookups:

```go
func (o *Orchestrator) GetL2EL(id stack.L2ELNodeID) (L2ELNode, bool) {
    if el, ok := o.l2ELs.Get(id); ok {
        return el, true
    }
    rbID := stack.NewRollupBoostNodeID(id.Key(), id.ChainID())
    if rb, ok := o.rollupBoosts.Get(rbID); ok {
        return rb, true
    }
    // ... check OPRBuilder too
}
```

### Solution

Capability interfaces capture shared behavior without the incompatible `ID()` method:

```go
type L2ELCapable interface {
    L2EthClient() apis.L2EthClient
    L2EngineClient() apis.EngineClient
    ELNode
}
```

Polymorphic lookup by key:

```go
sequencer, ok := FindL2ELCapableByKey(registry, "sequencer", chainID)
// Returns whichever L2ELCapable component has that key
```

### Changes

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `stack/capabilities.go` | L2ELCapable interface and registry helpers |
| `stack/capabilities_test.go` | Comprehensive test suite (9 tests) |
| [Design document](https://www.notion.so/oplabs/Devstack-ID-Type-System-Refactor-2eef153ee1628048bb7ade1030fe6e9b) | Phase 3 implementation notes |

### Test Plan

- [x] `L2ELCapableKinds()` returns expected kinds
- [x] `RegistryFindByCapability` finds all implementing components
- [x] `RegistryFindByCapabilityOnChain` filters by chain
- [x] `FindL2ELCapableByKey` polymorphic lookup works
- [x] `FindL2ELCapableByKey` prefers L2ELNode when multiple types share a key
- [x] Polymorphic scenario test demonstrates the use case

topPRs.title: op-supernode: prevent hang on shutdown
topPRs.author: geoknee
topPRs.body:
We have seen some tests hang for 2 hours and have suspected an unclean shutdown of supernode as the culprit. 

This PR:
* introduces a test which reproduces the issue
* patches the issue by ensuring the metrics service always decrements the wait group counter (previously it was only doing this on an error, so we were relying on an error to trigger a clean shutdown)
* introduces more logging into the shutdown logic
* tries to tighten up abstractions and patterns around lifecycle generally (but there is more work to do here). 

Without patch: 
```
➜  supernode git:(gk/supernode-shutdown) ✗ go test . -run TestCleanShutdown -v
=== RUN   TestCleanShutdown
=== PAUSE TestCleanShutdown
=== CONT  TestCleanShutdown
    supernode.go:124:           INFO [02-24|11:13:30.007] supernode starting                       version=test
    metrics_service.go:35:      INFO [02-24|11:13:30.007] starting metrics router server           addr=127.0.0.1:0
    supernode.go:191:           INFO [02-24|11:13:30.008] supernode stopping
    supernode.go:139:           INFO [02-24|11:13:30.018] starting RPC router server               addr=127.0.0.1:59965
    supernode.go:201:           INFO [02-24|11:13:30.018] rpc server stopped
    supernode.go:210:           INFO [02-24|11:13:30.018] metrics server stopped
    supernode.go:217:           INFO [02-24|11:13:30.018] rpc router closed
    supernode.go:227:           INFO [02-24|11:13:30.018] runnable activity stopped                activity=*supernode.mockRunnable
    supernode.go:240:           INFO [02-24|11:13:30.018] all chain containers stopped, waiting for goroutines to finish
    supernode.go:169:           INFO [02-24|11:13:30.018] activity closing due to cancelled context
    shutdown_test.go:66: Stop() did not return within 3m20s — supernode hung on shutdown
--- FAIL: TestCleanShutdown (200.00s)
FAIL
FAIL	github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/op-supernode/supernode	200.911s
FAIL
```

With patch: 
```
➜  supernode git:(gk/supernode-shutdown) ✗ go test . -run TestCleanShutdown -v
=== RUN   TestCleanShutdown
=== PAUSE TestCleanShutdown
=== CONT  TestCleanShutdown
    supernode.go:124:           INFO [02-24|11:08:49.571] supernode starting                       version=test
    supernode.go:191:           INFO [02-24|11:08:49.571] supernode stopping
    metrics_service.go:35:      INFO [02-24|11:08:49.571] starting metrics router server           addr=127.0.0.1:0
    supernode.go:139:           INFO [02-24|11:08:49.581] starting RPC router server               addr=127.0.0.1:59701
    supernode.go:201:           INFO [02-24|11:08:49.582] rpc server stopped
    supernode.go:210:           INFO [02-24|11:08:49.582] metrics server stopped
    supernode.go:217:           INFO [02-24|11:08:49.582] rpc router closed
    supernode.go:227:           INFO [02-24|11:08:49.582] runnable activity stopped                activity=*supernode.mockRunnable
    supernode.go:240:           INFO [02-24|11:08:49.582] all chain containers stopped, waiting for goroutines to finish
    supernode.go:169:           INFO [02-24|11:08:49.582] activity closing due to cancelled context
--- PASS: TestCleanShutdown (0.01s)
PASS
ok  	github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/op-supernode/supernode	0.950s
